summary: Review complete for QA-only offline deployment rehearsal commit 69dfeafbdd05f73dd9d66e0bfacdaf35b2352248. The script operates strictly in isolated temporary directories using fixture data, binds exclusively to loopback addresses on OS-assigned ephemeral ports, enforces socket-level network restriction guards, writes no production or old-source data, and cleanly stops its own child process instances.
